characters.prompt_specification: Production pixel art transparent animation atlases. Adults: 8 columns x 3 rows, front/right/back walking loops, same identity and foot anchor in all frames, empty hands. Male: white beard, green soft cap, olive tunic, brown belt and boots. Female: ginger braids, white bonnet, green bodice, cream apron, rust red skirt. Child: 4 columns x 2 rows, right walk and hop, blue pompom cap, green tunic, no beard. No labels, ground, gridlines, or shadows. Costume color mapping, carried goods, work tools, and dining gestures are applied by the runtime.

notes: Inspection mode uses a fresh game without auto-saving.
School children in this older feod branch are decorative animated figures, not family simulation units.
Building side views use mirrored artwork, not separately painted directional facades.
Special combat poses still use the legacy animation renderer.
Ground, building bodies, furniture and actors are separate depth-sorted layers.
Roadside fences block movement; routes are rechecked before each step.
